description: Strongest in the opening (about 6-10 stones) on the left-centre: my stone at row 2 of column 1 (on top of their stone), their stone at row 2 of column 3 (on top of mine), and an empty cell between them at row 2 of column 2, best when I also hold the bottom of column 2 and I moved first. Shifted or mirrored versions do not fire. Most weak firing near the threshold has no clear pattern.
effect: Small. At the strong motif, zeroing it takes about 5-8 points off column 3. Forcing it high on weak positions sometimes raises column 3 (once by +35 points, taken from column 2) but usually changes little.
program:
def score_(b):
    g = b.grid
    s = 0
    if g[1][1] == 1: s += 2
    if g[1][3] == 2: s += 2
    if g[0][3] == 1: s += 1
    if g[1][2] == 0 and b.heights[2] <= 1: s += 1
    if b.me_first: s += 1
    if b.ply <= 12: s += 1
    if b.heights[0] == 0: s += 1
    return s

def fires(b):
    return score_(b) >= 7

def level(b):
    return min(9, score_(b))
notes: The top tail is a specific left-centre opening motif, location- and colour-specific (relative to mover) and sensitive to move order. Near-threshold firing is diffuse. Scores: absolute-colour conjunction F1 0.09; relative conjunction 0.11; additive cell score (best, submitted) F1 0.186 P 0.16 R 0.22 AUROC 0.59 sim share 0.10; stricter additive 0.158. Could be a mixture or random direction with one strong opening pattern. Synth 3,1,2,5,1,3 = 17.53 beats dev max 17.41.
